A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent no. 4 - Project Director, National Highways Authority of India, Project Implementation Unit, Dhanbad on 14.01.2021, the relevant paragraphs of which read as under:
7.
That the petitioners have efficacious alternative remedy to file application before the Arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 for reassessment of compensation.

The Additional Collector has been appointed as an arbitrator to adjudicate the disputes with regard to compensation under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act 1956, if either of the parties are aggrieved by it,
then an application has to be preferred before the arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

8. That the respondent no. 3 as a Competent authority has no authority to demand additional amount by amending the valuation after payment of compensation has been paid to the beneficiary, Competent Authority has no jurisdiction to review its Award.
Competent Authority is empowered to review unless the provision of law permits, i.e. the statute provides for the power of review, an award once passed in itself becomes final.

The position of law also is well settled on the basis of the judicial pronouncements that the power of review is not an inherent power; it must be conferred by law either specifically or by necessary implication.
A review is always considered to be a creature of statute and the power of review cannot be entertained in the absence of a provision thereof.

sentences.text: That vide letter No. 994 dated 14.08.2020, this deponent pursuant to the letter dated 08.08.2020 has requested the Competent Authority to submit 3G Award for Additional amount for the structure (Annexure-9 series to the writ petition).

10. That this deponent has never received letter No. 436 dated 21.08.2020, moreover,
this deponent wants to submit that respondent No. 3 has filed its counter affidavit dated 27.08.2020 and in this counter affidavit, the respondent no. 3 has not stated a single line regarding that he has requested this deponent to deposit additional amount of Rs.25,70,884.00 for amended compensation.

Considering the said stand taken by the respondent no. 4 in the aforesaid counter affidavit, let a counter affidavit be filed on behalf of the respondent no. 3 - the District Land Acquisition Officer,
Bokaro within three weeks bringing on record the proof of service of letter no. 436 dated 21.08.2020 issued by him to the respondent no. 4.
A copy of amended/supplementary award be also brought on record as has been mentioned in the letter dated 21.08.2020.
Put up this case under the heading "For Admission" in the week commencing from 10.04.2023.
